text:
rachel: Auditor requested an evidence bundle for CVE-2026-2101 showing the full remediation chain: vuln report -> ticket -> PR -> CI artifact -> deploy -> audit logs (k8s/cloud) -> KMS activity + attestation. Sampling is OK.
pablo: I have the ticket INFSEC-902 and PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4120 (branch: fix/cve-2026-2101). Deploy tag: infra-v2026.2.4 deployed 2026-02-21T02:09Z.
neeraj: Plan: produce a sampled package with redacted logs. Proposed redaction: HMAC-SHA256(email_or_ip, bundle_salt) where bundle_salt is generated per-evidence and stored in internal-keystore. Auditor: is that acceptable?
auditor_linda: HMAC approach acceptable. Provide algorithm, salt storage policy, and a signed manifest. I need one PDF per control mapping to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12.
rachel: Good. We'll include: manifest.json, control-crosswalk.pdf, pr-and-ci.pdf (screenshots allowed), redacted-logs.tar.gz, kms-pseudonymized.csv, attestation-signed.pdf. Bundle will be sigstore-signed and SHA256 hashed.
pablo: Extraction notes for k8s slice (example):
```
kubectl logs -n infra audit-collector --since=72h | jq 'select(.objectRef.name=="infra-api")' > /tmp/infra-audit.json
```
I'll run a redaction pass to replace principalEmail/IPs with HMACs.
neeraj: KMS example query (BigQuery):
```
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, resourceName
FROM `prod.logs.kms_events`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName IN ("Encrypt","Decrypt")
  AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP("2026-02-18") AND TIMESTAMP("2026-02-22")
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 2000;
```
Then pseudonymize principalEmail with HMAC-SHA256(email, bundle_salt).
auditor_linda: Also include CI artifact hash (sha256) and the deploy pipeline run link or screenshot. Redacted screenshots OK. Provide attestation: originals retained and available under NDA for forensic review.
secops: Security note: originals are retained in internal-keystore for 7 years per retention policy. Bundle manifest will reference the internal artifact IDs but not include secrets. Mapping (original -> HMAC) will remain internal, access via compliance on request and under NDA.
rachel: Packaging plan: evidence manifest will note algorithms (HMAC-SHA256), salt storage path (internal-keystore/evidence/1781234560), sigstore signature (rekor entry), and bundle SHA256. We'll also include a short playbook snippet showing detection timeline.
eeraj: Pseudonymization snippet (python):
```
import hmac, hashlib
SALT = b"<bundle_salt>"
def hmac256(v): return hmac.new(SALT, v.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
```
Documented in README.
evidence-bot: packaging job started: evidence-1781234560-bundle.zip (building 6 artifacts). ETA ~90s.
pablo: One question: Cloud provider logs contain source IPs. Security prefers HMAC instead of redaction. OK?
secops: HMAC of IP is fine. Keep original logs in internal-keystore; document that mapping method and that originals are retrievable under NDA.
auditor_linda: HMAC acceptable. I may request one unredacted sample line under NDA for verification. Provide escalation contact in README.
eeraj: Upload complete: gs://redwood-compliance/evidence/1781234560/evidence-1781234560-bundle.zip (4.6MB). sha256: a3f4c2b7... Manifest contains full checksums and rekor signature URL.
rachel: Added PR to compliance mapping repo: https://github.com/redwood/compliance/pull/162 with the control crosswalk and filenames.
auditor_linda: I'll validate and ACK or request NDA sample. Thanks everyone.
pablo: Tagging INFSEC-902-EVID and closing loop once auditor confirms they can open package.
secops: Added short KMS attestation: HSM-backed keys, rotation schedule, and key version IDs used during deploy window. Attached in attestation-signed.pdf.
